Variable speed limit coming to Upper Hutt schools from 1 July

Drivers in Upper Hutt will soon see variable speed limits of 30km/h introduced outside 19 schools as part of a mandatory national road safety. Find out more.

Close this announcement

Water services - Important information

Our water services are changing. Tiaki Wai is the new organisation that will deliver water services across Upper Hutt, Lower Hutt, Porirua and Wellington from 1 July 2026. Find out more.

Strong engagement on future direction of Transport Strategy

Published on 22 June 2026

Strong community feedback received during consultation on Upper Hutt City Council's Draft Integrated Transport Strategy will now be used to refine and finalise the strategy later this year.

Variable speed limits coming to Upper Hutt schools on 1 July

Published on 18 June 2026

Variable speed limits will be introduced outside schools across Upper Hutt from 1 July 2026. Find out why the changes are happening and what they mean for drivers.

New prices at H₂O Xtream from 1 July 2026

Published on 16 June 2026

Following Council's annual review of its fees and charges, some prices at H₂O Xtream will change from Wednesday, 1 July 2026.
